verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page lists a first-party "Export/import feature flags for easy migration" capability, which directly supports moving data out. The Admin API also offers programmatic access to all resources, but that is a building block rather than an export feature. The evidence covers only feature-flag export, not "all of my data". Missing for 10: documented export of all data types (users, projects, segments, environments, events), explicit open/standard export formats such as JSON or CSV, detailed export docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration
